rows.label: Prisma Shade
rows.note: 500 Ducats + 300,000 credits, only when in his rotating stock

rows.label: free Companion Slot
rows.note: one for Prisma Shade, one for its Prisma Burst Laser

conditions: Without two free Companion slots the purchase fails; clear or buy a slot, relogging does nothing.
Baro stocks it only some visits, and gaps run from two weeks to most of a year.
bonuses: The purchase includes the Prisma Burst Laser, a separate Mastery item, already built.
During TennoCon, Baro's special relay stocks everything he has sold, so a ticket holder can buy it regardless of rotation.

disclosures.title: pairing and mod order
disclosures.body: Shade's invisibility comes from its Ghost precept mod and breaks only on shooting or melee, not on Warframe abilities, so caster frames such as Nokko, Vauban, Xaku, Gara and Jade pair well. Put Ghost in the last slot so Shade does everything else before cloaking.

disclosures.title: level both for full Mastery
disclosures.body: Prisma Shade and the Prisma Burst Laser are separate Mastery items, 6,000 and 3,000 points. The Burst Laser levels while equipped on the Sentinel.
